tur.hazir_degil: The guided tour is not ready yet. Its steps will be added with the science team’s scenarios.

ai.yedek: Commentary will appear here once values are computed. It only describes results the site has computed and never produces numbers of its own.

alt.metin: Built by Quasar Team for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

hata.metin: There is no page at this address.

meta.ana: Compare landing sites and dates at the lunar south pole by Sun and Earth conditions.
meta.planla: The best landing parcels for a launch date and launch site.
meta.uzman: Threshold filters, power and communication balance, battery and DSN analysis.
meta.site: The 360° horizon of a parcel, Sun and Earth tracks, countdowns.
meta.karsilastir: Two parcels or two dates side by side.
meta.gorevler: The most important lunar landing missions in history.
meta.hakkinda: Data sources, method, validation and limitations.

ana.soru: Which day, which spot to land?
ana.alt: At the pole the Sun and Earth move just above the horizon. A small change in place or date can completely change power and communication.
ana.sahne_not: The 3D scene will come from the animation team. Lighting will use the real Sun position and the phase will match the moment of your visit.
ana.kutup_alt: Values are computed for the moment you opened the page.
ana.gosterge_enerji: Energy it receives from the Sun
ana.gosterge_bekliyor: The indicator method awaits science team approval.
ana.anlati_2: The Sun on Earth and the Sun at the lunar pole
ana.anlati_3: Why does a small shift in position matter so much?
ana.anlati_4: Why does Earth wobble in the lunar sky?
ana.anlati_bekliyor: Text will come from the science team and visuals from the animation team.

planla.giris: Pick a launch date, a launch site and a route. The system ranks suitable parcels and explains why.
planla.kalkis_bekliyor: The launch site list has not been added yet.
planla.kalkis_etki: Until the launch model arrives, the launch site does not change the result.
planla.yol_sure: Transfer durations await science team approval.
planla.gecikme_bekliyor: The slider range will come with the date search window.
planla.tarih_hesap: The date search will be computed once the data pipeline is in place.
planla.harita_not: The parcel grid and suitability colours will come from the data pipeline.
planla.sonuc_not: Each parcel is listed only after passing four validation tests.
planla.sonuc_bekliyor: Ranking weights and parcel metrics are pending.

uzman.giris: Every number with its unit and definition. The Planner scenario carries over by link, so nothing is entered twice.
uzman.suzgec_metin: Minimum sunlight fraction, minimum contact time, longest darkness, slope and distance to ice regions.
uzman.pareto_metin: Parcels stand side by side on both needs instead of being reduced to a single score.
uzman.batarya_metin: Does this parcel, on this date, with this battery, survive the darkness?
uzman.dsn_metin: Which station sees the Moon at that moment, and the real communication window.
uzman.belirsizlik_metin: How the result changes inside the parcel and in neighbouring parcels if you miss the target.
uzman.benzer_metin: Options to look at if this parcel does not work.
uzman.aylik_metin: Which parcel is suitable on which days in the coming months.
uzman.bekliyor: The method and thresholds await science team approval.

site.parsel_yok_metin: Pick a parcel from the Planner list or enter coordinates below.
site.panorama_not: The terrain silhouette will be drawn from horizon profiles and the Sun and Earth tracks from the ephemeris.
site.geri_sayim_bekliyor: The set definition and ephemeris are pending.
site.cizelge_metin: Sunlit, partial and dark periods, and communication windows.
site.oynatici_bekliyor: The player will work once the panorama and cards share one clock.
site.astronot_not: A 3D scene for looking around as if you had landed will come from the animation team.
site.dis_not: Opening with the same location and date will be added once link formats are verified.
site.koordinat_not: Custom coordinate results will be interpolated from nearby points.

karsilastir.giris: Two parcels, or two dates at the same parcel, side by side.
karsilastir.secim_bekliyor: The selection comes from Site detail and the Planner.

gorevler.giris: The ten most important lunar landing missions in history, with their landing sites.
gorevler.kure_not: The globe and the camera flight between missions will come from the animation team.
gorevler.liste_bekliyor: The mission list, country, date and outcome will come from the science team.

hakkinda.giris: Which data LUNARIS uses, which method, and where it can be wrong.
hakkinda.kaynak_spice: Positions of the Sun and Earth relative to the Moon.
hakkinda.kaynak_lola: Elevation maps we derive horizon profiles from.
hakkinda.kaynak_horizons: Independent check of Sun and Earth positions.
hakkinda.kaynak_quickmap: Visual comparison with terrain and illumination layers.
hakkinda.kaynak_moontrek: A wide view of the terrain around a site.
hakkinda.yontem_bekliyor: A plain description of the method will come from the science team.
hakkinda.dogrulama_metin: Each row shows what was measured, against what, and the difference.
hakkinda.halka_inis_karsi: Darkness entry times in mission reports
hakkinda.dogrulama_bekliyor: The validation run will be done with the data pipeline.
hakkinda.sinirlamalar_bekliyor: The list will be published once the science team approves it.
hakkinda.ekip_metin: LUNARIS is Quasar Team’s project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Fundamental science, software and animation teams work on it together.
hakkinda.video_bekliyor: The video will be added before submission.
